> import re,struct
> txt=open('/tmp/dis.txt').read().splitlines()
> # parse instructions: lines like '  401234:  f2 0f ...  mnemonic ...'
> inst=[]
> for ln in txt:
>     m=re.match(r'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s*(([0-9a-f]{2}\s){1,15})?(.*)$',ln)
>     if not m: continue
>     addr=int(m.group(1),16)
>     bytestr=m.group(2) or ''
>     nbytes=len(bytestr.split())
>     rest=m.group(4)
>     inst.append((addr,nbytes,rest))
> # build map addr-> (nbytes,rest)
> byaddr={a:(n,r) for a,n,r in inst}
> # find function names
> funcmap={} # addr->name
> for a,n,r in inst:
>     mm=re.match(r'<([\w.]+)>:',r)
>     if mm: funcmap[a]=mm.group(1)
> # for each inst, find enclosing function (nearest preceding label)
> consts={}
> for a,n,r in inst:
>     fm=re.search(r'\[rip\+0x([0-9a-f]+)\]',r)
>     if not fm: continue
>     if 'movsd' not in r and 'movss' not in r: continue
>     disp=int(fm.group(1),16)
>     if disp>=0x80000000: disp-=(1<<32)
>     tgt=a+n+disp
>     if 0x3000<=tgt<0x32c0:
>         # find function
>         fname=None
>         for fa in sorted(funcmap):
>             if fa<=a: fname=funcmap[fa]
>         consts.setdefault(tgt,set()).add(fname)
> # decode
> rodata=open('orig','rb').read()[0x3000:0x32c0]
> for tgt in sorted(consts):
>     off=tgt-0x3000
>     d=struct.unpack('<d',rodata[off:off+8])[0]
>     if abs(d)<1e6 or d!=d:
>         print('rodata+%d = %.10g  used by %s'%(off,d,sorted(consts[tgt])))

> import re, struct
> txt=open('/tmp/dis.txt').read().splitlines()
> funcs={}
> inst_addr=[]
> for l in txt:
>     m=re.match(r'^([0-9a-f]+)\s+<([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)>:$', l)
>     if m:
>         funcs[int(m.group(1),16)]=m.group(2); continue
>     mi=re.match(r'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s', l)
>     if mi:
>         inst_addr.append(int(mi.group(1),16))
> order=sorted(funcs)
> def fname(a):
>     f=None
>     for fa in order:
>         if fa<=a: f=funcs[fa]
>     return f
> binf=open('/app/orig','rb').read()
> res={}
> for l in txt:
>     mi=re.match(r'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s', l)
>     if not mi: continue
>     a=int(mi.group(1),16)
>     m=re.search(r'movss.*\[rip\+0x[0-9a-f]+\].*#\s*([0-9a-f]+)', l)
>     if m:
>         tgt=int(m.group(1),16); kind='f32'
>     else:
>         m=re.search(r'movs[dsd]|movup[sd]|movap[sd].*\[rip\+0x[0-9a-f]+\].*#\s*([0-9a-f]+)', l)
>         if not m:
>             m=re.search(r'\[rip\+0x[0-9a-f]+\].*#\s*([0-9a-f]+)', l)
>             if not m: continue
>             kind='f64'
>         else:
>             kind='f64'
>         tgt=int(m.group(1),16)
>     try:
>         if kind=='f32':
>             d=struct.unpack('<f', binf[tgt:tgt+4])[0]
>         else:
>             d=struct.unpack('<d', binf[tgt:tgt+8])[0]
>     except: continue
>     res.setdefault(fname(a),[]).append((hex(tgt),round(d,6),kind))
> for fn in sorted(res):
>     print('=== %s ==='%fn)
>     seen=set();
>     for t,d,k in res[fn]:
>         if (t,d) not in seen:
>             seen.add((t,d)); print('  ',t,d,k)

> import re, struct
> txt=open('/tmp/dis.txt').read().splitlines()
> funcs={}
> for l in txt:
>     m=re.match(r'^([0-9a-f]+)\s+<([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)>:$', l)
>     if m: funcs[int(m.group(1),16)]=m.group(2)
> order=sorted(funcs)
> def fname(a):
>     f=None
>     for fa in order:
>         if fa<=a: f=funcs[fa]
>     return f
> binf=open('/app/orig','rb').read()
> res={}
> for l in txt:
>     mi=re.match(r'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s', l)
>     if not mi: continue
>     a=int(mi.group(1),16)
>     if 'movss' in l: kind='f32'
>     elif any(k in l for k in ('movsd','movups','movaps','movupd','movapd')): kind='f64'
>     else: continue
>     m=re.search(r'#\s*([0-9a-f]+)\b', l)
>     if not m: continue
>     tgt=int(m.group(1),16)
>     try:
>         d=struct.unpack('<f', binf[tgt:tgt+4])[0] if kind=='f32' else struct.unpack('<d', binf[tgt:tgt+8])[0]
>     except: continue
>     res.setdefault(fname(a),[]).append((tgt,round(d,6),kind))
> for fn in sorted(res):
>     print('=== %s ==='%fn)
>     seen=set()
>     for t,d,k in res[fn]:
>         if (t,d) not in seen:
>             seen.add((t,d)); print('  +%d  %r  %s'%(t-0x3000,d,k))
